epics.title: Dossier Report Access Control
epics.jtbd: When an analytical report is generated, I want its access restricted based on the user's department and courses, so that closed reports are not globally accessible.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Percentage of generated reports lacking access control fields (target 0%)
requirements: R1: When the DossierReport is saved, its accessDepartment and accessCourse fields must be populated from the user's Moodle department and courses

slices.title: Patch Dossier Report Generation to Populate Access Fields
slices.jtbd: When implementing report saving for this epic, I want to extract the user's Moodle department and courses from the security context and set them on the DossierReport entity, so that access restrictions are automatically enforced
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated user with a Moodle department and courses
When they generate an analytical report
Then the saved DossierReport must have its accessDepartment and accessCourse fields set correctly, and an integration test must verify this behavior
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 0% of generated reports lack access control fields in tests

requirements: R1: When processing the Moodle SSO callback, the system must first exchange the authorization code for an access token via the token endpoint before calling the userinfo endpoint

slices.title: Fix Moodle SSO OAuth2 Token Exchange
slices.jtbd: When implementing Moodle SSO callback processing for this epic, I want to securely exchange the authorization code for an access token, so that the OAuth2 flow completes according to standard and securely fetches the user profile
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid Moodle authorization code
When the system processes the SSO callback
Then it must call the token endpoint for an access token, use it to call the userinfo endpoint, and an integration test must mock these endpoints to verify the correct sequence
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of SSO logins successfully exchange code for token
